incident-bot: Pagerduty alert: P0 Dedicated GPU pool usage > 98% (reserved-pool-eu-west). Paging oncall SRE.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created — #INC-2026-174987. Assigned to Anya (SRE). Initial impact: enterprise tenant 'Sunflare' (reserved) experiencing high queue growth and throttling.

Anya (SRE): I'm on it. Observability shows queue depth 14k, avg GPU util 99.6%, eviction rate spiked. Looks like autoscaler didn't spawn due to rate limit errors.

Jay (Infra): Confirming autoscaler logs: "rateLimitExceeded: scale API throttled" starting 1749879900. Also saw controller backoff loop on ephemeral nodes.

Miguel (Eng Runtime): Runtime telemetry: KV cache saturation + many long-running sessions from Sunflare — each session pins 2x A100 reservations. Noisy neighbor effect.

Lee (Eng Runtime): We have fallback-compatible hosted model variants available (gpt-small-optim) that would reduce GPU pressure by ~60% but customer traffic is pinned to dedicated pool. Propose temporary routing rule to allow overflow.

Anya (SRE): Agree. Two parallel actions: (1) enable overflow routing to hosted for best-effort requests, (2) throttle Sunflare non-critical sessions and trigger eviction for idle/long-sessions. Need infra approval to modify routing policy. @Jay please.

Jay (Infra): I can flip the circuit-breaker to allow spillover. Patching control-plane config now. Command I'm running: 
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/api/v1/pools/reserved/eu-west/overflow -d '{"enable":true,"target_variant":"hosted-gpt-small-optim","max_pct":30}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
```
ETA ~90s.

incident-bot: Control plane change recorded: overflow enabled by Jay at 1749879998.

Lena (Customer Success): Notifying Sunflare CSM. We should give them heads-up that some traffic may be routed to hosted variants with slightly different latency/quality. Oliver, can you own customer comms?

Oliver (Accounts): On it. Drafting message to Sunflare support + AM. Will include mitigation steps and expected ETA for autoscaler fix.

Miguel (Eng Runtime): While overflow is in progress, I'll open an eviction wave for sessions older than 10m that are idle or low qps. Running soft-evict first to avoid customer-visible errors. Patch to runtime: 
```
# soft eviction policy
PATCH /runtime/v1/pools/eu-west/evictions
{ "age_sec": 600, "min_qps": 0.05, "mode": "soft" }
```
Applying now.

Lee (Eng Runtime): Confirmed soft-evict started at 1749880020. Observing immediate drop in active sessions ~4.1k within 2 minutes. Queue depth down to 9.2k.

Anya (SRE): Good. But autoscaler still failing to request new nodes due to API rate limit on our cloud account. Jay, can you throttle non-critical control-plane integrations to free quota?

Jay (Infra): Yes. Identified a noisy telemetry job spamming scale-intents every 2s (staging->prod misconfig). Pausing job now. Also increasing scale retry window to reduce hammering.

pagerduty-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled in 45m. Current assignee remains Anya.

Anya (SRE): After pausing noisy job, cloud API errors decreased. Autoscaler started new instance requests at 1749880085. One node pool accepted 4 nodes (A100) at 1749880140.

Miguel (Eng Runtime): New capacity coming online. Rebalancer is moving volumes; KV cache warmup in progress. Queue depth now 5.8k and falling. Throttling rate down from 32% to 12%.

Lena (Customer Success): Sunflare replied — they see some degraded responses but overall lane stable. They asked for timeline to full restoration.

Oliver (Accounts): Told them we're expecting autoscaler to reach steady state within 18-25 minutes given instance spin-up and warmup.

Kai (Product): Can we get a postmortem once this is wrapped? Need to know why tenant was allowed to pin so many reservations and why autoscaler rate limits weren't prevented.

Anya (SRE): Agreed. I'll convert to SEV post-incident and own the initial timeline. Immediate next steps: (1) let overflow stay enabled for 30m, (2) monitor evictions for false positives, (3) follow up with infra for rate limit guardrails, (4) notify account team.

incident-bot: Action items logged: overflow_enabled, soft_eviction_wave, noisy_job_paused, infra_rate_limit_followup.

Miguel (Eng Runtime): Current metrics snapshot: reserved-pool-util 87%, hosted-fallback-util 22%, queue 3.1k, avg-latency 410ms.

Anya (SRE): Looks stable. I'll remain on for the handoff in 30m and close after 2 consecutive 5m windows under thresholds. If anyone sees re-escalation, re-pager immediately. :thumbsup:

Lena (Customer Success): Thanks team, keeping Sunflare updated.

Oliver (Accounts): Noted. Will schedule a follow-up call with customer AM.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-174987 marked as "Mitigated (monitoring)" at 1749880240.

Anya (SRE): Closing thread here once monitoring confirms no regression. Postmortem owners: Anya (lead), Jay (infra), Miguel (runtime).
